name: repeatedly extract the extreme
mechanism: repeatedly find the smallest remaining element and move it to the end of the output; a heap makes each extraction logarithmic

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Selection sort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting: pick the smallest of the remaining elements, add it to the end of the sorted list
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Heapsort': convert the list into a heap, keep removing the largest element from the heap and adding it to the end of the list
